entities.name: Gustavo Martínez Frías
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gustavo Martínez Frías was the Archbishop of Nueva Pamplona, Colombia. Martínez Frías was appointed Archbishop of Nueva Pamplona by Pope John Paul II on March 18, 1999 and installed on May 6, 1999. He remained archbishop until his death on August 29, 2009, at the age of 74.
